name: ZDLVelvet
description: Dynamic Velvet Decorrelator, 115dkk MIT core adapted for Plus. Mono-to-stereo default. Experimental: never save.

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/wet amount; mono modes stereoize the selected input.

params.name: Time
params.explanation: FIR duration in tenths of a millisecond, 1 to 100 ms.

params.name: Dens
params.explanation: Density in four impulses/second per step, minimum 100.

params.name: Evol
params.explanation: Renewal interval in tenths of a second, minimum 0.1 s.

params.name: XFade
params.explanation: Transition duration in milliseconds; limited to 90% of interval.

params.name: Decay
params.explanation: Attenuation at the last FIR tap in dB.

params.name: Var
params.explanation: Deterministic variation added to the original default seed.

params.name: Input
params.explanation: Mono L, mono R, or independent stereo inputs.
